description: Watch a brand, usually a competitor, by its website or domain. A brand already in the Sequenzy email gallery is watched at once (status available) and its emails can be read with list_watched_brand_emails; any other brand is requested and its emails show up once it is added and they are collected. New emails arrive a few hours after they are sent. Watching again keeps the one watch (a new note replaces the old) and returns created false. A company can keep up to 50 watches and brand requests together. It is not your own website. Requires templates:write.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

note.description: Optional, up to 300 characters: what you want to see from them, such as their onboarding emails.

website.description: The brand's website or domain, such as competitor.com or https://competitor.com/pricing.

name: watch_brand

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `watch_brand` MCP tool.

created.description: False when the company already watched this domain.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

watch.description: The watch: id, domain, note, status, declineReason, watchedAt, emailCount, latestEmailAt and brand.
